local_context.value: Bartow (Wikipedia): county seat of Polk County; 'a terrain consisting of flatland interspersed with gently rolling hills'; sandy soils; average annual precipitation about 50.88 in with heaviest rain June-September; described as in 'lightning alley'; hurricane-force winds reach the Polk area less than once every ten years on average (Hurricane Donna 1960 was the last before 2004); 2020 Census: 7,682 housing units, 8.5% vacant; three National Register historic districts (listed 1993): Bartow Downtown Commercial, Northeast Bartow Residential (built from 1886), South Bartow Residential (204 contributing properties); Wikipedia says a city board regulates new construction in historic districts. NWS Tampa Bay: rainy season May 25 to October 10.

neighborhoods.value: South Bartow Residential District; Northeast Bartow Residential District; Bartow Downtown Commercial District (all NRHP, 1993). Only 3 found; no official city neighborhood list found.

Unincorporated Polk parcels go to the Polk County Building Division instead (county permitting line (863) 534-6080, per county page polkfl.gov/services/building).
